About Us
The Bartholomew County Veteran Services Office exists to honor and support the men and women who have served our country, along with their families, by providing comprehensive, compassionate services. Through advocacy, resource connection, and guidance, we strive to ensure that every veteran and their loved ones in our community have access to the benefits and support they have earned.
Office Hours
Office Hours: Mon-Fri, 8:00AM- 4:00PM
Public Hours: 9:00AM- 3:30PM
Staff
Veteran Service Officer: Jim Stevens
Assistant Veteran Service Officer: Larry Garrity
Veteran Services Receptionist: Angel Walker
Please contact the office to schedule an appointment with a VSO or to schedule a ride to a VA medical appointment.

Transportation
Veteran Medical Transportation Services
The Bartholomew County Veteran Services Office offers transportation for our local veterans to and from medical appointments at both Wakeman VA Clinic, Edinburgh, and Roudebush VA Hospital, Indianapolis.
Our team of volunteer drivers pick up and drop off, by appointment, Monday- Friday. Federal holidays and weekends excluded.
Call the office at (812) 379-1540 to schedule all van rides.
